status: Measured optimum along two independently measured orthogonal directions.
limitations: The step sizes are measured, but the measurement uses the PUBLIC score. Public-subset moments are approximated by full-test moments, so the realised public score may differ slightly from the prediction.
Optimising against public feedback is adaptive fitting to ~30k rows; the private split may not reproduce the full gain.
This exploits measured directions only. It does not identify the target.
